sum_insured.value: Rs. 5,00,000 to Rs. 25,00,000 specified in Policy Schedule (illustrations show 5 Lakhs, deductible illustration shows up to 25 Lakhs)
sum_insured.quote: Sum Insured means the amount specified in the Policy Schedule, for which premium is paid by the Policyholder

deductible.value: Optional deductible applicable on aggregate basis as specified in the Policy Schedule
deductible.quote: The Deductible shall be applicable on an aggregate basis for all Claims made by the Insured Person in a Policy Year.

co_payment.value: Optional co-payment as specified in the Policy Schedule
co_payment.quote: If this Optional Benefit is opted, then the Insured Person will have an option to bear a Co-payment, as specified in the Policy Schedule

co_payment_conditions.value: 20% co-payment for treatment in non-listed hospitals under Smart Select optional benefit
co_payment_conditions.quote: If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III to the Policy Terms and Conditions, then the Policyholder/ Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 20%
co_payment_conditions.name: Smart Select Non-Annexure III Hospitals

room_rent_limit.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred

icu_limit.quote: The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on ICU Charges incurred towards stay in ICU

initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident

pre_existing.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage

specific_diseases.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

pre_hospitalization.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital

post_hospitalization.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital and claim documents to be submitted within 30 days after the completion of 180 days

day_care.value: Covered up to Sum Insured for all Day Care Treatments
day_care.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person for Medical Expenses incurred on all Day Care Treatments through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility, maximum up to the Sum Insured

ambulance.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person, through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility, up to the Sum Insured, provided that the Medical Expenses so incurred are related to the Illness or Injury

restoration.value: Unlimited automatic recharge up to base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year
restoration.quote: the Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year which is valid for that Policy Year only

cumulative_bonus.value: 50% enhancement per year up to a maximum of 100% of Sum Insured
cumulative_bonus.quote: the Company will enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis, as a Cumulative Bonus for each completed and continuous Policy Year

ayush.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person, through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility, up to the Sum Insured, as specified in the Policy Schedule, towards Medical Expenses incurred with respect to the Insured Person's medical treatment undergone at any AYUSH Hospitals

modern_treatments.value: Up to the Sum Insured for specified advance technology methods
modern_treatments.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured, as specified in the Policy Schedule, for expenses incurred under Benefit 'Hospitalization expenses ' for treatment taken through following advance technology methods

maternity_cover.value: Not covered (permanently excluded under base policy, except ectopic pregnancy)

key_exclusions.value: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.
key_exclusions.name: Investigation & Evaluation

key_exclusions.value: Rest cure, custodial care, and respite care excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
key_exclusions.name: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl05 - Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care

key_exclusions.value: Obesity and weight control surgical treatments excluded unless specific strict BMI and medical criteria are satisfied
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfill all the below conditions
key_exclusions.name: Obesity/Weight Control

key_exclusions.value: Cosmetic or plastic surgery excluded unless reconstructive following accident, burns, or cancer
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer
key_exclusions.name: Cosmetic or Plastic Surgery
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl08 - Cosmetic or plastic Surgery

key_exclusions.value: Professional hazardous or adventure sports participation excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports
key_exclusions.name: Hazardous or Adventure Sports
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause Excl09 - Hazardous or Adventure sports

key_exclusions.value: Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof.
key_exclusions.name: Alcoholism and Substance Abuse
key_exclusions.clause_label: Clause 9 - Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or

key_exclusions.value: Refractive error correction for eyesight below 7.5 dioptres excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.
key_exclusions.name: Refractive Error

key_exclusions.value: Sterility, infertility, assisted reproduction and contraception excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to sterility and infertility. This includes: (i) Any type of contraception, sterilization (ii) Assisted Reproduction services
key_exclusions.name: Sterility and Infertility

key_exclusions.value: Maternity expenses traceable to childbirth, miscarriage, or abortion excluded (except ectopic pregnancy)
key_exclusions.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy
key_exclusions.name: Maternity Expenses

key_exclusions.value: Routine eye/ear exams, dental appliances, external prosthetics, walkers, wheelchairs, and sleep apnea instruments excluded
key_exclusions.quote: Charges incurred in connection with routine eye examinations and ear examinations, dentures, artificial teeth and all other similar external appliances and / or devices
key_exclusions.name: External Appliances and Devices

planned_intimation.value: At least 48 hours prior to planned admission
planned_intimation.quote: In case of an Planned Hospitalization, the Company shall be notified either at the Company's call center or in writing at least 48 hours prior to planned date of admission to Hospital

emergency_intimation.value: Within 48 hours of hospitalization commencing or before discharge
emergency_intimation.quote: In case of an Emergency Hospitalization, the Company shall be notified either at the Company's call center or in writing immediately and in any event within 48 hours of Hospitalization commencing or before the Insured Person's discharge

reimbursement_documents.value: Within 30 days of discharge from hospital
reimbursement_documents.quote: all the information and documentation specified in Clause 6.1.4 and Clause 6.1.5 shall be submitted to the Company at Policyholder's / Insured Person's own expense, immediately and in any event within 30 days of Insured Person's discharge from Hospital.

free_look_period.quote: The Insured Person shall be allowed free look period of 30 days from date of receipt of the policy document to review the terms and conditions of the policy

grace_period.value: 15 days for monthly mode, 30 days in all other cases
grace_period.quote: The grace period for/payment of the premium for all types of insurance policies shall be: fifteen days where premium payment mode is monthly and thirty days in all other cases.

moratorium_period.quote: After completion of five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of five years is called as moratorium period.

summary.overview: Care Supreme provides comprehensive hospitalization coverage with no room rent or ICU capping and generous 60-day pre and 180-day post-hospitalization expense coverage. It features unlimited automatic reinstatements of the base sum insured within the policy year and a 50% cumulative bonus per year up to 100%.
best_for: Individuals and families seeking high-coverage indemnity without room rent restrictions
Patients needing robust coverage for advanced modern medical treatments and day care procedures
Policyholders looking for unlimited SI restoration for both same and different illnesses
watch_outs: Standard 36-month waiting period for pre-existing diseases unless an optional modification cover is purchased
20% co-payment applied to all claims if the Smart Select optional discount is active and non-Annexure III hospitals are used
Blacklisted hospitals list (Annexure II) where non-emergency claims will not be covered at all
Maternity expenses and infertility treatments are excluded under base coverage
next_actions: Verify that your preferred local hospitals are not listed in Annexure II (excluded hospitals)
Check whether the 'Smart Select' optional discount is selected to avoid unexpected 20% co-pays
Submit reimbursement claims within 30 days of discharge (or within 30 days after the 180-day post-hospitalization window)

risks.title: 20% co-payment: Smart Select Non-Annexure III Hospitals
risks.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies when this condition is met (20% co-payment for treatment in non-listed hospitals under Smart Select optional benefit).
risks.quote: If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III to the Policy Terms and Conditions, then the Policyholder/ Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 20%

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Excluded Hospitals Denial
risks.explanation: Except for emergency stabilization, treatments availed at any of the dozens of excluded hospitals listed in Annexure II will be rejected.
risks.quote: Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Insurer... are not admissible.

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Arthritis, Osteoarthritis, Spinal Disorders, Joint Replacement Surgery) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

risks.title: Proportionate Deduction if Room Rent Modification Opted
risks.explanation: While base coverage has no room rent limit, opting for the Room Rent Modification discount will trigger proportionate deductions on associate medical expenses if you stay in an upgraded room.
risks.quote: then, the Policyholder/Insured Person shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Associate Medical Expenses (including applicable surcharge and taxes thereon)

risks.title: Strict Claim Filing Deadline
risks.explanation: Hospitalization claims must be reported within 48 hours and submitted within 30 days of discharge to avoid potential contestation.
risks.quote: the Company shall be notified with full particulars within 48 hours from the date of occurrence of event... Claim must be filed within 30 days from the date of discharge
